milestone: CodeForge Model Picker R1 — Restore the Real Free-Model Product Architecture

rootCauseFinding.description: registerCloudAdapter() — which lists CodeForge's hosted, server-owned-key-backed free catalog — was only invoked when the user already had a stored cloud sign-in token, even though GET /v1/hosted/models requires no authentication (only POST /v1/hosted/inference does). A fresh, signed-out install therefore only ever saw the single bundled generic placeholder model.

additionalFindings.description: A BYOK-connected provider's own free-of-charge model was bucketed into the same generic top-5 'FREE' section as CodeForge's no-credential catalog, violating the requirement that credential-required models never appear in the credential-free section.
Header trust badge always rendered the literal string 'ForgeZero · Verified Free' regardless of the actually selected model's real verified-free status.
'Pause Agent while typing' <select> had no CSS class, rendering as an OS-default bright control inside the dark UI.
Locked GEMS models showed 'Unavailable' (implies a broken feature) instead of 'Coming soon' (accurate — GEMS has never shipped a usable model).
Settings led with 'Configure Providers' with no indication CodeForge Free/ForgeAuto need no setup.
'0 Available Credits' shown with no distinction between free/ForgeZero execution and paid credit consumption.
